falsification_contract.HYPOTHESIS: expected effect holds: Incipient inverter failure signatures (reactance/inductance variation, flux weakening, current imbalance) are detected while propulsion is still available, so the warning is issued with residual torqu (recorded prior 0.6, epistemic class MODEL_DERIVED per the killer-experiment provenance)
falsification_contract.TREATMENT: Add a fault-detection layer to the rear inverter control software that consumes existing signals (desat pins, phase currents, DC-link voltage, switching duty, module temperature) and runs three detectors in parallel: desat-event latching, phase-current/DC-link consistency checks, and ripple-based ESR/capacitance tracking. On confirmed detection, command a graded torque derate to preserve the healthy path, and drive a two-stage driver alert: (a) immediate dramatic alert (loud tone, instrument-cluster + center-screen banner, hazard-lamp flash) with a displayed "propulsion shutdown in ~N s" countdown updated from the thermal/DC-link margin estimate, and (b) a final imminent-shutdown alert at the measured depletion threshold. The derate and countdown are coupled so the displayed time matches the actual derate trajectory.
